label: batch-52
tail:
Completed batch 52: both pages, 10 A-page items (including five local carriers), two B examples, manifests, proof contracts, coverage, and cross-batch evidence are authored. All 12 assigned items have current `ready` Step 1 records; these record authoring readiness, not independent approval.

The finite metaplectic proof uses the full relevant [Robbin–Salamon 1992](https://ncatlab.org/nlab/files/RobbinSalamonMetaplectic.pdf) and [1993](https://webhomes.maths.ed.ac.uk/~v1ranick/papers/robbsala2.pdf) papers. The added graph-core result is proved locally; its Sobolev sources include [Kinnunen](https://math.aalto.fi/~jkkinnun/files/sobolev_spaces.pdf) and [Laugesen](https://publish.illinois.edu/rlaugesen/files/2023/07/554-Lectures.pdf). Locators, dispositions, and fetch stamps are in the [coverage record](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-non-fluid-129-2026-10-21-r2-batch-52.coverage.json).

Checks passed: precheck 12/12; proof-layout 12 items, 41 steps, zero defects; strict proof contracts, content policy, and rendercheck; source fetch 7/7; coverage checklist 20 results, zero errors; scoped dependency levels 12 items, zero errors; depcheck zero errors or warnings.

Two run-wide checks remain owner-controlled: item-level checking reports 78 empty inventories in other batches and stale levels on three other items; batch dependency levels reports the shared schedule stale. I left those files unchanged. The `plan-spec.json` empty item arrays versus the design inventory are also documented in the [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-non-fluid-129-2026-10-21-r2-batch-52.notes.md). The [manifest](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-non-fluid-129-2026-10-21-r2-batch-52.pages.json) and [proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-non-fluid-129-2026-10-21-r2-batch-52.proof-contracts.json) reflect the completed batch.
